samples.question: The image shows two separate state registers, left and right. In each register, start at the ringed phase and read operation cards 1 through 5 from top to bottom. A right arrow advances one step through phases 1, 2, 3, then back to 1; a left arrow moves one step backward; a diamond swaps phases 2 and 3 while leaving phase 1 fixed. Apply every operation in order. Do the two registers finish at the same phase? Answer yes or no.
